- Total revenue reached £154.7k in TW versus £145.0k in LW, a WoW gain of 6.6%.
- Total units came in at 103,003 in TW, up 21.8% WoW, while total orders reached 397, up 18.9% WoW.
- United Kingdom ranked 1 with £143.7k in TW, holding a 92.9% share of total revenue.
- Channel Islands ranked 2 at £3.4k in TW (2.2% share) and EIRE ranked 3 at £1.9k (1.2% share), with the top three countries accounting for 96.4% of TW revenue.
- United Kingdom posted the largest absolute WoW gain at £13.2k, followed by Channel Islands at £2.6k.
- Switzerland recorded the largest absolute WoW decline at £6.4k, and Germany fell £1.8k WoW.
- France led percent growth with a WoW increase of 349.8%, ahead of Channel Islands at 334.5% WoW.
- Switzerland showed the steepest percent drop at 82.0% WoW, with Germany down 62.5% WoW.
